description: Resting heart rate derived from photoplethysmography (PPG) on the E4 wristband. Row 1 = Unix start timestamp; Row 2 = sample rate; Row 3+ = one BPM value per line.
notes: Used as primary cardiac signal in Deviation Detector and Intelligence Layer; mapped to RESTING_HR key in all engines

description: Wrist skin temperature recorded at 4 Hz. Readings below 25°C are device warm-up artefacts and are excluded by the adapter.
notes: NOT core body temperature. Downsampled to per-minute medians internally. Warm-up artefacts auto-rejected.

file_format: timestamp-offset + value pairs (seconds since session start + IBI duration in seconds)
description: Inter-Beat Interval recorded on every detected heartbeat. Column 1 = seconds offset from session start; Column 2 = IBI duration in seconds. Converted to milliseconds internally.
notes: Irregular sampling - one entry per heartbeat not fixed Hz. Values outside 100-2000 ms are rejected as artifact.

description: Electrodermal Activity / Galvanic Skin Response recorded at 4 Hz. Present in all sessions but NOT currently mapped to any intelligence-layer signal.
notes: Disclosed limitation: EDA is collected but not processed by the current health intelligence layer.

description: Raw photoplethysmography signal at 64 Hz. Used internally by the E4 to derive HR and IBI. Not directly used as a standalone signal endpoint in the intelligence layer.
notes: High-frequency raw PPG. HR (EP-001) and IBI (EP-003) are derived from this signal.

file_format: E4-header (3-row: timestamp / sampleHz / values per axis)
description: 3-axis accelerometer. Each row has 3 comma-separated values (X Y Z). Used for motion artifact detection in the E4 hardware but not surfaced as a standalone intelligence signal.
notes: 3 values per row (x,y,z). Largest file in each session (~6.9 MB for S1-Final).

availability: Knee flexion range of motion in degrees. Part of the synthetic patient scenario dataset for TKA and ACL patients. NOT present in the PhysioNet wearable-exam-stress dataset.
example_value: Present in PAT-TKA-101 (Sarah Jenkins) and PAT-EX-404 (Marcus Chen) and PAT-STROKE-202 scenarios only.

description: Numeric Rating Scale pain score (0 = no pain, 10 = worst possible). Part of synthetic patient scenarios. NOT available in real wearable dataset.
notes: Present in PAT-TKA-101, PAT-STROKE-202, and PAT-EX-404 scenarios. Changes day-by-day to simulate clinical trajectories.

description: Total daily step count. Synthetic signal simulating activity monitor output. NOT present in real wearable dataset.
notes: Present in all 4 synthetic patient scenarios. Simulates rehabilitation activity levels and mobility trends.

description: Walking gait velocity in metres per second. Clinically relevant for post-stroke rehabilitation. Normal threshold >= 0.85 m/s.
notes: Present in PAT-STROKE-202 (Robert Vance) only. Stalls at 0.53 m/s to simulate rehabilitation trajectory stall.

description: Peripheral oxygen saturation measured by pulse oximetry. NOT in real wearable dataset. Part of heart failure scenario.
notes: Present in PAT-HF-303 (Elena Rostova) only. Drops to simulate fluid overload / pulmonary oedema.

description: Daily body weight. Clinically important for heart failure monitoring - sudden gain indicates fluid retention. NOT in real wearable dataset.
notes: Present in PAT-HF-303 (Elena Rostova) only. Gains ~0.6 kg/day to simulate fluid overload trajectory.

source_type: Referenced in Bounds / Not Actively Sourced
availability: Bounds Defined - No Active Data Source
description: Systolic blood pressure bounds are defined in the Deviation Detector for artifact rejection (40-280 mmHg) but no actual BP data source or adapter currently feeds this signal.
notes: Bounds are registered in isArtifactNoise() for future compatibility. No CSV file or data source currently provides BP values.

source_type: Referenced in Bounds / Not Actively Sourced
availability: Bounds Defined - No Active Data Source
description: Diastolic blood pressure bounds are defined in the Deviation Detector for artifact rejection (20-160 mmHg) but no actual BP data source or adapter currently feeds this signal.
notes: Bounds are registered in isArtifactNoise() for future compatibility. No CSV file or data source currently provides BP values.

availability: Swelling/oedema score is listed in UNAVAILABLE_SIGNALS in the exam-stress catalogue. No data source or adapter exists for this signal.
example_value: Disclosed limitation of the current dataset. Listed in UNAVAILABLE_SIGNALS array in exam-stress-catalogue.js.

availability: Gait velocity is catalogued as unavailable in the PhysioNet wearable-exam-stress dataset. Available only in synthetic PAT-STROKE-202 scenario.
example_value: Absent from Empatica E4 sensor set. Explicitly disclosed as unavailable in exam-stress-catalogue.js.

description: 29 subjects (subject_01 through subject_29) each have their own folder containing ACC.csv BVP.csv EDA.csv HR.csv IBI.csv TEMP.csv files.
notes: These subjects come from the Real-HR-Test dataset distinct from the PhysioNet wearable-exam-stress dataset (S1-Final).

description: Session identifier formed as {subjectId}-{sessionLabel} e.g. S1-Final. Covers S1-S10 across Midterm1 Midterm2 Final sessions (30 total).
notes: Only S1-Final is bundled locally. All others require download from PhysioNet (open access no login required).

description: Unique patient identifier for the 4 synthetic clinical scenarios: PAT-TKA-101 PAT-STROKE-202 PAT-HF-303 PAT-EX-404.
notes: 4 synthetic patients cover: TKA post-op infection, post-stroke rehab stall, heart failure tele-rehab, ACL reconstruction.

description: Day number since surgery/discharge. Used by the Deviation Detector to evaluate trajectory lag against expected recovery benchmarks.
notes: Used in evaluateTrajectoryLag() in deviation-detector.js. Critical for contextualising signal deviations against post-op recovery curves.
